text.p: Swedish forestry group AssiDoman is expected to report a profit after financial items of 1.62 billion crowns for the first nine months of the year, a Reuter poll of 13 analysts showed on Wednesday.
This would mean a fall of 53 percent compared with the nine-month 1995 profit of 3.41 billion crowns.

The forecasts ranged between 1.50 billion crowns and 1.83 billion, with a median of 1.60 billion. The average estimate has fallen by 209 million crowns since the last Reuter poll ahead of the six-month results.
The average of analysts' forecasts indicated a profit of 2.21 billion crowns for the full year, compared with the 4.35 billion posted in 1995.
AssiDoman is due to publish its nine month figures on November 12.
Source: Aros, Carnegie, Danske Bank, Enskilda, Fiba, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley, Nordbanken, Nordiska, Salomon.
